/scripts.value:
on RemoveDeletedBlank
	local tCurrentBlankNumber = 0
	local tActiveBlank
	local tQuestionText
	
	repeat with xChar = 1 to the number of characters in currentQuestionDataQuestionText 
		if character xChar of currentQuestionDataQuestionText = "_" then
			if tActiveBlank = true then
			else
				put true into tActiveBlank
				add 1 to tCurrentBlankNumber
				if tCurrentBlankNumber = blankLineToDelete then
					get answerdialog("What would you like to do?","Remove Blank","Replace w/ Word")
					if it = "Replace w/ Word" then
						set itemdelimiter to "|"
						put item 1 of line tCurrentBlankNumber of currentQuestionDataCorrectAnswer after tQuestionText
					end if
				end if
				
			end if
			
			if tCurrentBlankNumber = blankLineToDelete then
			else
				put character xChar of currentQuestionDataQuestionText after tQuestionText
			end if
		else
			put false into tActiveBlank
			put character xChar of currentQuestionDataQuestionText after tQuestionText
		end if
	end repeat
	
	set the text of field "QuestionText Input" of screen "Edit Questions V2" to tQuestionText
end RemoveDeletedBlank
